analysis.title: 11/16 Mkt Internal Insight: Resilient Flow + Even More Washed-out Positioning
key_insights: Excess flow showed only small sell flow despite the dip. With SPY -1.9% there was -$1 bn of excess sell flow, and with QQQ -2.7% only -$19 bn.
Within Nasdaq, excess flow was -$28 bn in the first hour, then turned to modest net buying of +$10 bn for the rest of the day.

UBS RMM clients bought the dip for a third day in a row, with net flow at the 45th percentile vs 3 years, after buying the rally in 5 of 6 days. Buying was concentrated in semiconductor stocks and ETFs and bond ETFs. There was small selling in software and tech hardware.
VIX cross-asset rank peaked at 92% with VIX as high as 25, after 1:35 pm. A reading above 95% is usually strong intraday resistance or an overbought condition.
UBS prime brokerage net leverage and long/short ratio are the lowest since July 2026 and close to the lowest since December 2022.
Leveraged ETP rebalance was -$18.3 bn to sell, of which -$15.1 bn in Nasdaq and tech, including -$6.3 bn in semis and -$1.9 bn in QQQ.
Risk control rebalance was net zero today, as buying triggered Friday was offset by selling triggered today. UBS expects small selling of -$10-15 bn tomorrow.

CTAs crossed no triggers today. ES1 has one close sell trigger at 7412 (-0.4%) and four close buy triggers between 7660 and 7705 (+3.0% to +3.6%). RTY1 has four close sell triggers and no close buy trigger. NQ1 has none.
risk_factors: VIX cross-asset rank above 95% would mark an overbought condition and strong intraday resistance.
RTY1 faces four close sell triggers, including two moving-average crossovers expected late this week or early next week, and no close buy trigger.
A 2% decline in SPX would trigger about $20 bn of risk control selling.
vol_and_positioning: VIX cross-asset rank peaked at 92% today with VIX at 25. Above 95% is usually strong intraday resistance or an overbought condition.
Risk control positioning is at the 57th percentile vs 1 year and the 2nd vs 5 years. CTA positioning is at the 1st percentile vs 1 year and the 5th vs 5 years.
UBS PB net leverage and L/S ratio are the lowest since July 2026 and close to the lowest since December 2022. Leveraged ETPs stand at $291 bn, the 11th percentile vs 1 year.
SPX short interest is 2.1% of float (74th percentile vs 1 year, 95th vs 5 years). CFTC exposure is -$111 bn (92nd and 67th percentile).
NDX short interest is 1.8% (46th and 89th percentile). CFTC exposure is $0 bn (100th and 99th percentile).
RTY short interest is 10.0% (92nd and 98th percentile). CFTC exposure is -$1.6 bn (57th and 42nd percentile).
Risk control rebalance scenarios for tomorrow: SPX +/-50 bps buys $10 bn, SPX +/-1% buys $5 bn, SPX +2% sells $5 bn, SPX -2% sells $20 bn.
Leveraged ETP top stocks to sell in dollars: NVDA, MU, AMD, AAPL, AVGO, MSFT, AMZN, INTC, TSLA, TXN. Top by percent of ADV: NXPI, MPWR, ADI, TXN, QCOM, KLAC, ON, TER, MCHP, ALAB.
